'''Fabrin''' was an [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Circarpous sector/Legends|Circarpous sector]]. It was home to the [[Fabritech/Legends|Fabritech]] corporation, which owned the entire world and attracted large sums of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|money]] from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] due to its demand for Fabritech's [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] products. The planet's surface featured both vast [[Factory/Legends|factory]] districts and luxurious [[Beach/Legends|beach]] resorts on which [[Programmer/Legends|programmers]] lived and worked.

==Description==
Fabrin was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="FDCR" /> located in the [[Fabrin system/Legends|Fabrin system]], a part of the [[Circarpous sector/Legends|Circarpous sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was situated on the [[Nanth'ri Route]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] between the [[Circarpous system/Legends|Circarpous]] and [[Gyndine system/Legends|Gyndine systems]].<ref name="TEA" /> Fabrin's surface featured plains and [[Beach/Legends|beaches]],<ref name="FDCR" /> and it shared its name with [[Fabrin (city)|Fabrin]], a [[City/Legends|city]] on<ref name="GG9">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]<ref name="TEA Thorgeld">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Thorgeld system/Legends|Thorgeld system]]</ref> planet<ref name="TRG1">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref> [[Thorgeld I]], where the [[Mandel family mansion|mansion]] of [[Kvarn Mandel]], the head of the [[Fabritech/Legends|Fabritech]] corporation, was located in.<ref name="GG9" />

==History==
Fabrin, home to the company Fabritech, greatly benefitted from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] efforts to re-vitalize the stagnant economy of the Expansion Region. The large sums of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|Imperial credits]] being transferred to Fabrin due to the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military's]] demand for Fabritech-manufactured [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] technology strengthened commerce along the entire Nanth'ri Route.<ref name="FDCR" />

==Inhabitants==
Fabrin was wholly owned and operated by the Fabritech corporation,<ref name="FDCR" /> which manufactured sensor and communications devices.<ref name="NEGWT" /> The company employed both [[Programmer/Legends|programmers]] and working-class overseers, as well as [[Droid/Legends|droids]], there.<ref name="FDCR" />

==Locations==
The headquarters of Fabritech and the majority of its manufacturing facilities were located on Fabrin.<ref name="NEGWT" /> Thousands of vast, droid-operated [[Factory/Legends|factories]] dedicated to a single product each dominated Fabrin's plains and formed manufacturing districts. In contrast, Fabritech programmers lived and worked on highly luxurious beach resorts.<ref name="FDCR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Fabrin was first mentioned in the [[2004]] reference book ''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]'' by [[W. Haden Blackman]].<ref name="NEGWT" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Fabrin [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the planet itself, in grid square O-12.<ref name="TEA" />
